question: What was the day of the week on 9 May 2022?
solution:
**Given date: **9th May 2022.

Now,

Till 2021 → 2000 + 21

 
 

 Type of Year
 Odd Days
 
 
 
 

 Leap Year

 Ordinary Year

In 21 years, 5 leap years and 16 ordinary years.

⇒ 0 + (5 × 2) + (16 × 1)

⇒ 10 + 16 = 26 odd days.

And, till 9th May

⇒ 31(Jan) + 28(Feb) + 31(March) + 30(April) + 9(May)

⇒ 129 days

Total odd days = 26 + 129 = 155 days = 155/7 = 22 week and 1 odd day.

→ 1 represents Monday.
